01

Getting Started

Everything in BiG happens through one web address — no separate app to install.

1.1 Signing in

Go to your BiG web address and sign in with the username and password given to you by your Administrator. There is no self-signup — accounts are created for you.

✕ Close

Forgot your password? — Ask an Administrator or Director to reset it for you; there is currently no self-service "forgot password" link.

1.2 What you'll see depends on your role

BiG shows you only what's relevant to your role and department. The screenshots in this manual are taken from an Administrator account, which sees the most — the table below shows how your own view will differ.

RoleWhat you'll see
Administrator / DirectorEvery module, every department, every event. Screens in this manual are captured from an Administrator account.
Team LeadSame modules, narrowed to your own department(s) — e.g. Box Office staff see Bookings/Registration, but the Admin section is limited to editing your own department's users.
VolunteerMy Department (your own attendance) and Profile. Other modules are hidden entirely unless you're also given specific access.
02

Your Home Screen

The Dashboard is the first thing you see after signing in — a live snapshot of the event.

2.1 Dashboard

Ticket sales, admission progress, accommodation bookings and volunteer numbers at a glance, plus breakdowns by pass type and admission status. Use the Event selector at the bottom of the sidebar to switch which event's data you're viewing.

✕ Close

2.2 My Profile

Click your name in the bottom-left corner any time to see your own details: role, department membership, permission level, and your own attendance history.

✕ Close
03

My Department

Where volunteer attendance is marked, reviewed and tracked.

Every role has a My Department screen, scoped to what you're allowed to see:

  • Administrator / Director — an all-departments reporting view, with tabs for Daily Summary, Department Calendar and All Users (shown below).
  • Team Lead — the same tools, narrowed to the department(s) you lead: mark attendance, review history, see your roster.
  • Volunteer — a read-only view of your own attendance record.
✕ Close

Attendance is recorded per date and shift (morning/afternoon/night), so it stays accurate even if a volunteer moves between departments mid-event.

04

Box Office

Bookings, walk-up registration, and gate check-in — available to Administrator, Director and Box Office department staff.

4.1 Bookings

Every order for the selected event, one row per booking. Search by name, email, order ID or ticket ID. Export downloads the current list as a spreadsheet; Bulk Upload imports pre-sold orders from a spreadsheet in bulk.

✕ Close

4.2 Booking detail & attendee actions

Click any booking row to open its detail panel on the right. From here you can see every attendee on the order, Check In an attendee at the gate, Edit their pass details, or jump to Open in Registration for the full lookup flow.

✕ Close

4.3 Registration (gate lookup & walk-ups)

The day-of screen for gate staff: scan a QR code or type an order ID, ticket ID, name, email or phone to pull up a booking instantly. Use + Spot Registration to register a walk-up attendee who wasn't pre-booked.

✕ Close
05

Accommodation (Tenting)

Filter and check tent-pass holders by tent category.

Filter attendees by tent type (Shared, Solo, Family, PYOT, Glamping) and use Check Festival Tickets to cross-check tent holders against festival admission.

✕ Close

Note — this screen is on the platform's older layout, pending a visual refresh already planned for a future release (see the HDL's Roadmap). It's fully functional in the meantime.

06

Admin

Platform configuration — visible to Administrator and Director; Team Leads get a narrowed view of Users only.

6.1 Users

Register new accounts, set role and home department, and grant department access at three tiers — Read, Write, or Manage — per department. Team Leads can view and edit users within their own department only, and cannot create new accounts.

✕ Close

6.2 Departments

Create departments, assign a Team Lead and volunteer roster, and see headcount at a glance. Deleting a department with people still assigned shows a reassignment warning first.

✕ Close

6.3 Events

Create and manage events, each with its own set of Pass Types (festival passes, tents, add-ons). An event's status (Draft / Active / Archived) controls whether Team Leads and Volunteers can see it. Use the sidebar's Event selector to switch which event the rest of the app is working against.

✕ Close
07

Quick Reference

Admitted
— an attendee has been checked in at the gate.
Bulk Upload
— importing many pre-sold bookings at once from a spreadsheet.
Pass Type
— a category of ticket or add-on belonging to one event (e.g. Festival Ticket, Solo Tent).
Spot Registration
— registering a walk-up attendee who wasn't pre-booked.
Department access tiers
— Read (view only), Write (edit), Manage (full control, including for a Team Lead's own department automatically).

For how the platform is built rather than how to use it, see the companion High-Level Design document.
